phaseReports.name: 720p24
phaseReports.readyToCompletionBoundary: Worker frame-ready → actual native allReferencesReleased; includes scheduling/import/consumer lifetime and Worker-to-main clock uncertainty, no screen scan or pure GPU-copy inference

freshness.uncertaintyPolicy: p95(abs drift + max(frame total uncertainty, frame Worker mapping + selected audio renderer mapping)); selected audio mapping components are required for formal evidence, no repeated Worker term
freshness.earlyFrameConstraint: absolute signed drift p95 must also stay within two periods; negative age never makes an early frame pass
freshness.model: latest calibrated real audio.currentTime sample at or before completion, extrapolated by rate within exact timelineResetId

freshness.policy: 1Hz state requests; unique main-observed native state updates, max age/gap 3000ms, phase endpoint coverage within 2000ms

displayGeometry.boundary: full backing pixels transported; CSS size is not full-resolution screen presentation

phaseReports.resourceObservationSampling: asynchronous /proc inventory, per-snapshot start/end and mapping error are retained in original events/report; trend time is bracket midpoint, not atomic main snapshot
